suites.title: KCM Transactional Email Architecture & Security Tests

specs.title: 1. Production email template must NOT contain DEV SANDBOX NOTICE
2. Production email subject must NOT contain [Sandbox Preview] prefix
3. Rendered HTML must NOT contain raw CSS text fragments leaked as body text
4. User input containing XSS and HTML injection vectors must be safely escaped
5. Plain-text version must exist and contain no raw HTML tags
6. LOGIN_ALERT template must contain all required church security details and links
7. Missing optional fields must not render as "undefined" or null
8. Idempotency guard must prevent duplicate emails within deduplication window
